status: independent_checkpoint_complete; determinant microscopic energy remains open
results: Exact reconstruction of the OA113 additive-only pair-energy theorem and its sufficient tree-bag proof interface.
Primary DPP single-replica gap lifts to a standard k-volume additive pair-energy inequality with coefficient 4kn.
That lift and constant-partition constrained-DPP sampling do not cover the n-block pair-restricted hard-BCS target.
Two exact examples block direct transfer of strongly-Rayleigh exchange and local activity-comparability arguments; no general impossibility is shown.
